name: freefamilydisplay
description: Self-hosted family dashboard. Admin UI + kiosk renderer for wall displays.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@ffd/web
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@ffd/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@ffd/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force && tsc -p packages/log/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/db/tsconfig.tools.json && npm run typecheck --workspace=@ffd/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
